findings.body: `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods build_occurrence_and_event_data, counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values` is raised, aborting detector processing instead of returning results; previously the class was concrete and returned an empty result list.
findings.failure_mode: Runtime exception during detector handler construction for the metric alert group type.
findings.impact: `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods build_occurrence_and_event_data, counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values` is raised, aborting detector processing instead of returning results; previously the class was concrete and returned an empty result list.
findings.root_cause: The class was re-parented to the abstract `StatefulDetectorHandler` (which declares four abstract members, including the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`) while its body was reduced to `pass`, leaving abstract members unimplemented for a class that is registered as `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler`.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide concrete stub implementations of `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data` on `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` (raising `NotImplementedError`/returning defaults) instead of `pass`, or keep it registered only once it is fully implemented.
findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler becomes abstract and can no longer be instantiated
findings.trigger: Any code path that resolves a `Detector` whose `type` is `metric_alert_fire` and reads `Detector.detector_handler`, which executes `group_type.detector_handler(self)` (e.g. `process_detectors` on a metric alert data packet).
findings.verifier_reason: The patch shows MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler (which declares abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data per lines 144-170 in detector.py) with body 'pass'. The class is registered as detector_handler for MetricAlertFire (line 27). When Detector.detector_handler property calls group_type.detector_handler(self) (detector.py:86), instantiation will fail with TypeError for unimplemented abstract methods.

pr.body:
This adds a hook that can be implemented to produce an occurrence specific to the detector that is subclassing the StatefulDetector.

Also change the signature of evaluate to return a dict keyed by groupkey instead of a list. This helps avoid the chance of duplicate results for the same group key.
